name: image-router
label: ImageRouter
description: Generate images with any model available on ImageRouter.

token.label: API Key
token.description: Your ImageRouter API key. You can get your API key from the [ImageRouter API Keys page](https://imagerouter.io/api-keys).

createImage.label: Create Image
createImage.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using any available model

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image you want to generate

quality.label: Quality
quality.description: Image quality (not all models support this)

size.label: Size
size.description: Image size (e.g., 1024x1024). Use "auto" for default size.

responseFormat.label: Response Format
responseFormat.description: How to receive the generated image

image_router_generate_image.label: Generate Image
image_router_generate_image.description: Generates images from a text prompt and returns their URLs.

model.label: Model
model.description: Model id, e.g. "openai/gpt-image-2". Use List Models to find ids and what each model supports.

quality.label: Quality
quality.description: Output quality for models that support it. Defaults to auto.

size.label: Size
size.description: "auto" or WIDTHxHEIGHT such as "1024x1024". Allowed sizes per model are in Get Model. Defaults to auto.

outputFormat.label: Output Format
outputFormat.description: Image file format. Defaults to webp.

image_router_generate_video.label: Generate Video
image_router_generate_video.description: Generates a video from a prompt and an optional start image, and returns its URL.

model.label: Model
model.description: Video model id, e.g. "ir/test-video". Use List Models with output modality "video" to find ids.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: What the video should show. Most models need one.

image.label: Start Image
image.description: Optional start image for image-to-video models: an http(s) URL or a data URI.

size.label: Size
size.description: "auto" or WIDTHxHEIGHT such as "1280x720". Allowed sizes per model are in Get Model (sizes). Defaults to auto.

seconds.label: Duration (seconds)
seconds.description: Video length in seconds; allowed values per model are in Get Model (seconds). Defaults to the model default.

image_router_create_response.label: Create Response
image_router_create_response.description: Gets a reply from a text model in the OpenAI Responses format.

model.label: Model
model.description: Text model id, e.g. "openai/gpt-4o-mini". Use List Models with output modality "text" to find ids.

input.label: Input
input.description: The prompt as plain text. Use this or Input Items, not both.

inputItems.label: Input Items
inputItems.description: The input as a JSON array of OpenAI Responses input items, e.g. [{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"Describe this"},{"type":"input_image","image_url":"https://..."}]}]. Use this or Input, not both.

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.description: Optional system-level instructions for the model.

maxOutputTokens.label: Max Output Tokens
maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens in the reply. Leave empty for the model default.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature from 0 to 2. Leave empty for the model default.

additionalParameters.label: Additional Parameters
additionalParameters.description: Optional JSON object of other OpenAI Responses parameters passed as-is, e.g. {"top_p":0.9}. The fields above take precedence.

image_router_get_model.label: Get Model
image_router_get_model.description: Gets one ImageRouter model with its parameters and pricing.

modelId.label: Model ID
modelId.description: Exact model id, e.g. "openai/gpt-image-2", from List Models.

image_router_get_credits.label: Get Credits
image_router_get_credits.description: Gets the account credit balance and usage.

includeKeyUsage.label: Include Usage per API Key
includeKeyUsage.description: Also return usage for each API key on the account. Defaults to off.
